confirmed_facts.fact: Order ORD-2006 (electronics, AED 1299.00) was delivered 29 Oct 2026; return requested 1 Nov 2026, 3.2 days after delivery, inside the 7-day electronics window of Return v2.
Dispatch serial recorded and scanned at packing is WH900-55120.
Warehouse photo of the headphone band label shows serial WH900-55120, matching dispatch.
Warehouse inspection typed serial WH900-55210 by hand; the code comparison shows positions 9 and 10 are swapped.
Warehouse inspection found the left driver intermittent on test, consistent with the customer's reported fault.
Parcel was sealed at pickup at 0.81 kg and received at 0.80 kg (dispatch 0.80 kg); courier timeline is in order.

findings.description: The inspection serial differs from the dispatch serial by a swap of two adjacent digits. The warehouse photo of the label shows the dispatch serial, so the typed inspection value is likely a typing error. The contradiction is settled by the photo.

evidence.quote: Serial typed by hand from label
Barcode scan of serial label: WH900-55120

policy_references.quote: Scans and photos outrank typed records. A typed value that a photo contradicts is likely a typing error.
Items returned for a fault are eligible for a refund or replacement within the window if the fault is confirmed at inspection.
The refund amount is the item price paid. Delivery fees are not refunded.

findings.rationale: The only open contradiction, the serial difference, is settled by the warehouse photo and the dispatch scan, which both show WH900-55120; the inspection value looks like a hand-typing swap. The return is inside the 7-day window and the left-driver fault was confirmed at inspection. A person should review a refund of AED 1299 (item price, calculated by code) and may ask the warehouse to correct the typed serial.
findings.uncertainty_note: The typing error is inferred from the photo and the digit swap; the warehouse has not yet confirmed it. No other contradiction or missing evidence was found.
